autonomous_actions: change and test code in the authorized Hermes repository
repair reversible configuration and runtime paths
update internal knowledge, registries and runbooks
perform controlled deployment with backup and rollback
approval_required_actions: irreversible deletion without a verified restore path
new paid contract or financial commitment
superseded_policy_classes: blanket approval for reversible deploys, restarts, firewall or DNS work
blanket prohibition on direct push to the owner fork
owner question after a technically solvable error
re-audit of a component already covered by current verified evidence
secret_authority: Vault or existing secret store; n8n stores references only
source_of_truth: canonical Hermes VPS shared knowledge database
